title: Vectors
overview: A focused revision guide to vectors.

sections.title: Basics
content: Magnitude of a = (a₁,a₂,a₃) is |a| = √(a₁²+a₂²+a₃²). A unit vector in the direction of a is a/|a|.

sections.title: Scalar (dot) product
content: Set a·b = 0 to test perpendicularity; rearrange for cosθ to find the angle between two lines.

sections.title: Vector equation of a line
content: r = a + tb, where a is a position vector on the line and b is the direction. To find intersections, solve two component equations for the parameters, then check the third is also satisfied.

examTips: Always substitute back into the third equation to confirm the lines actually intersect — skew lines don't, and this check is often worth its own mark.
